# apicurio_artifact_version (Resource)

One explicit, immutable version of an artifact: the GitOps style where `v1`, `v2`, ... are separate resources, and the way to manage version metadata, state and drafts. The artifact must exist (an `apicurio_artifact` without `content`, or imported).

Content is immutable once the version is not a draft: a change of `content` or `references` replaces the resource (the version is deleted and created again under the same id, which needs `apicurio.rest.deletion.artifact-version.enabled=true`). While the version is a `DRAFT`, content changes are applied in place (`apicurio.rest.mutability.artifact-version-content.enabled=true` on the server). Do not manage the versions of one artifact both with this resource and with `apicurio_artifact.content`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The artifact itself, without content: its versions are explicit resources.
resource "apicurio_artifact" "price" {
  group_id      = apicurio_group.payments.group_id
  artifact_id   = "price"
  artifact_type = "AVRO"
}

# Immutable versions, one resource each. A change of content replaces the
# version (needs apicurio.rest.deletion.artifact-version.enabled on the server).
resource "apicurio_artifact_version" "v1" {
  group_id    = apicurio_artifact.price.group_id
  artifact_id = apicurio_artifact.price.artifact_id
  version     = "1.0.0"
  content     = file("${path.module}/schemas/price-1.0.0.avsc")
  name        = "Price 1.0.0"
}

resource "apicurio_artifact_version" "v2" {
  group_id    = apicurio_artifact.price.group_id
  artifact_id = apicurio_artifact.price.artifact_id
  version     = "2.0.0"
  content     = file("${path.module}/schemas/price-2.0.0.avsc")
  depends_on  = [apicurio_artifact_version.v1] # keeps the version order
}

# Retire the old version once consumers moved on.
resource "apicurio_artifact_version" "v1_deprecated" {
  group_id    = apicurio_artifact.price.group_id
  artifact_id = apicurio_artifact.price.artifact_id
  version     = "0.9.0"
  content     = file("${path.module}/schemas/price-0.9.0.avsc")
  state       = "DEPRECATED"
}

# A draft: no rules are applied and the content can change in place
# (apicurio.rest.mutability.artifact-version-content.enabled on the server).
# Setting state = "ENABLED" later promotes it, applying the rules.
resource "apicurio_artifact_version" "next" {
  group_id    = apicurio_artifact.price.group_id
  artifact_id = apicurio_artifact.price.artifact_id
  version     = "3.0.0-draft"
  draft       = true
  content     = file("${path.module}/schemas/price-3.0.0.avsc")
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `artifact_id` (String) Artifact the version belongs to. Changing it replaces the version.
- `content` (String) Content of the version, usually `file("schema.avsc")`. Compared as a document (reformatting is not a change). A change replaces the version unless it is a draft, where the content is updated in place. The registry does not serve the content of a `DISABLED` version: after importing one, the configured content is recorded as is and verified once the version is enabled again.
- `group_id` (String) Group of the artifact. Changing it replaces the version.

### Optional

- `content_type` (String) Media type of `content`; defaults from the artifact type (see `apicurio_artifact`). The configured value is kept in state (the registry reports the media type of the first upload of identical bytes).
- `description` (String) Description of the version.
- `draft` (Boolean) Create the version as a `DRAFT`: no rule is applied, the content can be changed in place, and the version is not part of the `latest` branch until `state` moves it out of `DRAFT`. Defaults to `false`. Changing it replaces the version.
- `labels` (Map of String) Labels of the version.
- `name` (String) Name of the version.
- `references` (Attributes List) References from the content to other artifact versions. Order does not matter. A change replaces the version (or updates a draft in place). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--references))
- `state` (String) State of the version: `ENABLED`, `DISABLED`, `DEPRECATED` or `SUNSET` (Apicurio Registry 3.3 and later). Defaults to `ENABLED`, or `DRAFT` for a draft. `DRAFT` cannot be configured (use `draft`), and a version never returns to `DRAFT`. Leaving `DRAFT` applies the configured rules against the newest version of the artifact that is not disabled (drafts included; the draft itself when nothing newer exists). The content of a `DISABLED` version cannot be read from the registry; the provider keeps the last known content.
- `version` (String) Version id (`[a-zA-Z0-9._-+]`, 1 to 256 characters), for example `1.0.0`. Numbered by the registry (`1`, `2`, ...) when unset. Changing it replaces the version.

### Read-Only

- `artifact_type` (String) Type of the artifact.
- `content_id` (Number) Content id (shared by versions with identical content).
- `created_on` (String) Creation time (RFC 3339).
- `global_id` (Number) Global id of the version.
- `id` (String) `group_id/artifact_id/version`.
- `modified_by` (String) User of the last modification.
- `modified_on` (String) Last modification time (RFC 3339).
- `owner` (String) Owner of the version.

<a id="nestedatt--references"></a>
### Nested Schema for `references`

Required:

- `artifact_id` (String) Referenced artifact.
- `group_id` (String) Group of the referenced artifact.
- `name` (String) Name the content uses for the reference.
- `version` (String) Referenced version.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Versions are imported by "group_id/artifact_id/version".
terraform import apicurio_artifact_version.v1 payments/price/1.0.0
```
